cases.q: What has he done for accessibility?
cases.answer: Craig has worked with accessible UI since building UI libraries held to WCAG for clients. He ensures his current site is accessible by default, maintaining WCAG 2.2 AA standards through an automated suite that checks for regressions after every deploy and every week. This suite includes checks for axe-core, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, reflow, spacing, and motion control. He also ensures that controls meet minimum target sizes and that text maintains a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1. See accessibility.md.
